item.text: {"decisions":[{"item_id":"feed:b0a8086cf13c4b186b995202","version_id":"eabf7f3ac465815c5c0c40e78394ae1c21e6639c77d966fafb4c9859c9a17f69","decision":"accept","reason":"October 2 publication falls within September 11–October 10 freshness window. Reported session observations provide relevant counterevidence about maintaining AI desk-research workflows: one participant retrieved wrong articles and spent 45 minutes repairing instructions; others could not locate underlying context files. Accept these as attributed observations and practical questions about traceability and maintenance, not representative failure rates or proven savings from the proposed remedies. The truncated excerpt omits sample size, recruitment, geography and study protocol; small-business transfer and non-English applicability remain uncertain. Customer-data handling and consent are not established. No cross-post or repeated underlying claim is evident among these candidates.","piece_ids":["02","03"]},{"item_id":"feed:b22689fdda57414e5b30cba0","version_id":"8a207c485426c60b72907c6e97153db69b8303d22d8d6e3342485ed4ac29f314","decision":"reject","reason":"October 9 publication is fresh, but this podcast summary covers infrastructure, consumer agents and financing rather than a substantive customer, competitor or market-research task. Its privacy and agent-access topics offer no inspectable evaluation or research workflow evidence; the full episode is not supplied. Event-ticket promotion adds a commercial incentive. The listed podcast and YouTube distributions are potential cross-posts of the same episode, not independent corroboration; no matching candidate is supplied.","piece_ids":[]},{"item_id":"feed:b3e89044c195d6f66141c957","version_id":"afdc0399b0f8a0499c3d10210002de491266d5781a9ff9a905236381818f5bb3","decision":"reject","reason":"October 6 publication is fresh and describes a concrete brand-tracking benchmark launch, but the supplied text establishes no AI research capability or practical small-budget access. This vendor demo promotion can establish its announced features, not independently validate growth prescriptions or effectiveness. Although it reports nearly 8,000 data points across 35 countries, it omits sampling, collection dates, weighting and regional cell sizes needed to assess benchmark transferability. References to established theory do not validate this norm pool; the vendor explicitly disclaims EBI affiliation or endorsement. Privacy protections are vendor assertions, not evidence of customer consent. No cross-post is evident in this batch.","piece_ids":[]},{"item_id":"feed:be7d32557d6f2583c9fe2942","version_id":"46c2224ee51604f79bf459904bd6dbd488ade884ec657a097c887aecaace1130","decision":"reject","reason":"September 28 publication is fresh, but this is a conference-keynote advertisement about general workforce roles, without a concrete research task, observed deployment or inspectable methods supporting its claims about agents and disappearing entry-level work. The author is the promoting organization's CMO, and conference registration, books and training create direct commercial incentives. The article says the same framework has appeared in the speaker's newsletter and podcast: those repeated underlying claims would not provide independent corroboration. It supplies no small-business cost, accuracy or implementation evidence.","piece_ids":[]}]}
